name: Ichijiku Konoka
source: A third-year college student, she was a member of [url=/c150926]Yukihisa[/url]'s team but is now a famous illustrator. However, she is bad at socializing and doesn't have any close friends at college. Although Yukihisa has asked her to rejoin his team, she initially declined, saying it's time to start job hunting. Her cold attitude towards him seems to stem from an unfortunate incident during their school days.
